draft.subject: Industrial AI for upstream and downstream operations – introduction to the Digital & Industrial fund
draft.body:
Dear Aramco Ventures Team,

I am Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based company that develops AI software for oil, gas and process operations. Given the Digital & Industrial fund's focus, I would like to introduce our work.

Our product lines include:
- Real-time field monitoring and analytics for oil and gas assets;
- Formation-damage detection and prevention during drilling, completion and production;
- AI-based artificial-lift optimisation;
- Gas-turbine and process digital twins with predictive maintenance;
- Energy, emissions and carbon management with reinforcement-learning optimisation.

The software is at advanced-prototype stage (TRL 4-5), developed and tested on synthetic and simulated data. Our next step is a field pilot with an operator to validate it on real data, and we are raising seed funding to support that.

We would welcome a short call to understand whether a pilot through Aramco's technology programmes, or an investment discussion at a later stage, could be relevant.

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye

draft.subject: AI for operational efficiency and emissions in energy operations – Parsa International Group
draft.body:
Dear Equinor Ventures Team,

I am Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based company developing AI software for energy operations. Equinor Ventures' interest in AI and digital solutions for the energy transition led me to write to you.

Our products address:
- Predictive maintenance and digital twins for rotating equipment and process units;
- Real-time monitoring and analytics for oil and gas fields and storage terminals;
- Energy, emissions and carbon management with optimisation of energy use.

The products are advanced prototypes (TRL 4-5) tested on simulated data. We are looking for a first industrial pilot to validate them on real operating data, and for early-stage funding.

We understand our stage is earlier than most Equinor Ventures investments. Would you be open to a short call, or could you point us to the Equinor innovation or pilot programme that works with companies at our stage?

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye

draft.subject: Question ahead of applying to the Hub71 Access Programme – AI for energy and healthcare
draft.body:
Dear Hub71 Team,

My name is Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based company developing AI software for the energy sector and healthcare. We are preparing an application to the Hub71 Access Programme and would appreciate guidance before we apply.

Our main products are:
- AI monitoring, predictive maintenance and digital twins for oil and gas operations, gas turbines and process plants;
- Energy and carbon management with real-time optimisation;
- Healthcare AI: automated analytics for diagnostic-kit data and multimodal early-risk assessment for neurodegenerative diseases.

The products are advanced prototypes (TRL 4-5). Abu Dhabi is our preferred base for the Gulf because of its energy and healthcare ecosystem, and we would like to run our first pilots there.

Could you advise which cohort and track would fit a company at our stage, and whether an introduction to Hub71's energy or healthcare partners is possible during the programme?

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye

draft.subject: AI for energy and healthcare – introduction ahead of applying to Antler MENAP
draft.body:
Dear Antler MENAP Team,

My name is Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group in Istanbul. We are a small team building AI software for energy and healthcare, and we are considering applying to Antler's Riyadh or Dubai programme.

We already have working prototypes (TRL 4-5) of:
- Industrial AI for oil and gas operations (monitoring, predictive maintenance, digital twins, energy management);
- Healthcare AI (diagnostic-kit data analytics and neurology risk assessment).

What we need most now is help with focus, our first paying pilot in the Gulf, and pre-seed capital. Before applying, we would like to ask whether Antler accepts an existing small company with prototypes into the programme, or whether the programme is mainly for founders forming new teams.

Thank you, and I look forward to your guidance.

Best regards,

Narges Farahani

draft.subject: Istanbul-based AI company for energy and healthcare – introduction ahead of our seed round
draft.body:
Dear Revo Capital Team,

My name is Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based company building AI software for energy and healthcare. Revo's focus on Turkish-rooted B2B companies in health tech and energy is very close to what we are building, so I would like to introduce us early.

Our portfolio includes:
- Industrial AI for oil, gas and process plants: field monitoring, formation-damage prediction, artificial-lift optimisation, gas-turbine digital twin and energy/carbon management;
- Healthcare AI: an automated analytics platform for diagnostic-kit data (qPCR/ELISA) with edge deployment, and multimodal early-risk assessment for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.

To be transparent about where we are: our products are advanced prototypes (TRL 4-5), we have not yet signed commercial customers, and we are now seeking pilot partners and a seed round. We understand Revo usually invests at Series A and B, so we would value a short conversation on what you would need to see from us, and on seed investors you co-invest with.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call in the coming weeks?

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye

draft.subject: B2B industrial AI from Istanbul – Parsa International Group introduction
draft.body:
Dear 212 Team,

I am Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group in Istanbul. We build B2B AI software for industrial operators, mainly in energy and process industries, and I would like to introduce us given 212's focus on B2B technology companies from Türkiye with regional reach.

What we do:
- AI monitoring and predictive maintenance for oil and gas fields, plants and storage terminals;
- Digital twins for gas turbines and process units;
- Energy, carbon and sustainability management with real-time optimisation;
- Selected healthcare AI products (diagnostic-data analytics, neurology risk assessment).

Our software is at advanced-prototype stage (TRL 4-5) and we are now looking for first pilot customers in Türkiye, the Gulf and Central Asia, together with seed funding to take two products to production. We know 212 typically leads Series A rounds, so our aim at this stage is to start a relationship, hear your view on what makes an industrial AI company investable for 212, and keep you updated as pilots progress.

Would a short introductory call suit you?

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye
